content.snl: %The default block-renderer registry contains list, enumerate, table, centered and right. It does not register matrix or svg_template. Extend it with a spread of defaultRenderers plus consumer-owned renderer keys; replacing hooks.renderers without that spread replaces the nested registry.%
content.markdown: The default block-renderer registry contains list, enumerate, table, centered and right. It does not register matrix or svg_template. Extend it with a spread of defaultRenderers plus consumer-owned renderer keys; replacing hooks.renderers without that spread replaces the nested registry.
